title: Remove or constrain BMP signature detection
origin: INST-0002 — BMP false positive causes dedup cascade
evidence_base: INST-0002 traced 525 files through the pipeline and found that 234 (44.6%) were eliminated at the dedup stage, primarily because a BMP false positive carved a 50MB region that overlapped with real files.
problem_statement: The BMP signature 'BM' (0x42 0x4D) is only 2 bytes long. These bytes appear frequently in random data within other files (JPEG, PNG, ZIP, PDF, DOCX). When the scanner finds 'BM' at a cluster start, it carves a 50MB 'BMP file' using the max-size heuristic (BMP has no footer). This 50MB carved region overlaps with all other files in the image, causing the dedup logic to eliminate real files.

proposed_fix.option_A: Remove BMP from SIGNATURES list entirely — simplest fix, removes the false positive entirely. BMP is a low-value format for carving (rare in forensic scenarios).
proposed_fix.option_B: Add BMP header validation — after finding 'BM', validate the DIB header structure (check BITMAPINFOHEADER size field, verify width/height are reasonable, check bits_per_pixel). This would eliminate most false positives while keeping BMP detection.
proposed_fix.option_C: Add minimum confidence threshold — BMP carves must pass additional validation (e.g., check that the file size declared in the BMP header matches the carved size). This is more robust but more complex.
proposed_fix.recommended: Option A — simplest, most effective, and BMP is a low-priority format for carving. If BMP detection is needed later, Option B can be added.

impact_analysis.if_applied: INST-0002 results suggest that removing BMP detection would eliminate 44.6% of file losses at the dedup stage. ZIP recovery would improve from 33.8% to near 100%, DOCX from 58.6% to near 100%, JPEG from 8.9% to near 100%, PNG from 62.2% to near 100%.
impact_analysis.if_not_applied: Carving motor will continue to produce incorrect results at scale. RC-A-003 will remain unresolved. All claims about carving performance are questionable.
impact_analysis.risk: LOW — removing BMP detection only affects BMP file recovery, which is a low-priority format. No other functionality is affected.

dependencies.must_be_applied_before: Re-running INST-0002 or any carving experiment

verification_plan.step_1: Apply the fix (remove BMP from SIGNATURES or add validation)
verification_plan.step_2: Re-run INST-0002 with the same configurations (N=15, 30, 100)
verification_plan.step_3: Verify that dedup loss rate drops to near 0%
verification_plan.step_4: Verify that recovery rates improve for all formats
verification_plan.step_6: Update IVM Carving Parser status to VALIDATED (if all stages pass)

relationship_to_rp_001: RP-001 (PDF footer fix) and RP-002 (BMP false positive fix) are independent. They can be applied in any order. Together, they address both root causes identified by INST-0002: RP-001 fixes the Judge loss (PDF 1-byte truncation), RP-002 fixes the Dedup loss (BMP false positive cascade).
